Only its start, under the Allyn's Lodge icons at (864,1293), is in my tiles. Traced on the source: it runs right, then down past two LOWER JESTER labels at ~(995,1590) and ~(1330,1800) to (1153,1967) near the Super Bravo base. The PDF draws it as one stroke with those two labels.
Short black line (496,1529)->(524,1775), with a single diamond and the LIXI'S TWIST label on it. Lower Twist (14) continues from its bottom.

Split it at the junction (800,1233), where piece 26 branches right. From the Lincoln Peak summit (945,885) down to that junction it is JESTER: the snowflake + square + JESTER label is printed along it at ~(838,940). The last ~60 px, (800,1233)->(807,1293), runs down the left side of Allyn's Lodge to the Super Bravo top, where the Valley House Traverse starts. The horizontal ALLYN'S TRAVERSE label (snowflake + blue square) is printed right against that segment on its left and vertically centred on it; no other line touches the label. The PDF has no stroke of its own for Allyn's Traverse: the Jester stroke runs to the lodge and the label was added at the end of the layer. OpenStreetMap matches: its Allyn's Traverse leaves Jester, passes the lodge on the south (map-left) side and joins the Valley House Traverse, while its Jester ends on the north (map-right) side of the lodge, like piece 26.

Short link from the Jester junction (800,1234) down-right to the front of Allyn's Lodge (864,1293), where Lower Jester (20) begins. In the PDF this stroke comes right after the Jester stroke and before the JESTER label.

From the Snowball/Valley House Traverse junction (586,1459), with the HEAVEN'S GATE TRAVERSE label (snowflake + blue square) along it, to (1064,1579). The second HEAVEN'S GATE / TRAVERSE label covers the continuation east of there.
